author: agent:claude-code
message: A misstep with its lesson, recorded when found.

title: CONTRIBUTING.md edited by hand though tend publishes it
body: In 7b44188 (the CI wording) and 8d6f80e (issues yes, code no) CONTRIBUTING.md was edited with the editor, but it's the published document `contributing`: tend writes every version back to the file, so it changes only through doc_write. tend check then reported 'published document contributing differs from CONTRIBUTING.md', and doc_write refuses until `tend doc sync contributing` (the user's) records the hand edits. bench/README.md and bench/flux/AUTODIFF.md are published the same way. Lesson: before editing a Markdown file, doc_read (no doc) lists which ones tend publishes; write those with doc_write, and re-import (doc_import) the ones it only holds, such as README.md.
